meta.name: auth-implementation-patterns
meta.description: Master authentication and authorization patterns including JWT, OAuth2, session management, and RBAC to build secure, scalable access control systems. Use when implementing auth systems, securing APIs, or debugging security issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为应用加上登录认证和权限校验,防止未授权访问
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发应用并需要实现用户登录和权限管理
copy.tagline_en: Add login and permission checks to your app to block unauthorized access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building an app and need to add user login and permission management

howto.what: 为你的项目提供认证与授权实现模式,涵盖 JWT、OAuth2、会话管理与 RBAC,帮你搭建登录系统、保护 API、排查认证与权限问题,并输出对应的代码模式与安全注意事项。
howto.when: 当你实现用户登录认证、给 REST 或 GraphQL API 加保护、排查认证安全问题时触发;设计会话管理、迁移认证系统、接入 SSO 等场景也适用。

say.text: 帮我用 JWT 做登录,访问令牌有效期设成 15 分钟
say.note: 会给出 JWT 签发与过期时间的实现模式

say.text: 给我的 REST API 加上 RBAC 角色权限校验
say.note: 会说明角色与权限检查的写法

say.text: 登录后一直返回 401,帮我排查是什么原因
say.note: 会按常见认证问题逐项定位

howto.what_en: Adds authentication and authorization patterns — JWT, OAuth2, session management, RBAC — to help build login systems, secure APIs, and debug auth and permission issues.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you implement user authentication, secure REST or GraphQL APIs, or debug security issues; also covers session design, auth migration, and SSO.

say_en.text: Help me add JWT login with a 15-minute access token lifetime
say_en.note: Covers token issuing and expiry patterns

say_en.text: Add RBAC role and permission checks to my REST API
say_en.note: Shows role and permission check patterns

say_en.text: My login keeps returning 401, help me find the cause
say_en.note: Walks through common auth failure causes
